t: Fixed Cloud Map endpoint resolution to correctly route to the dualstack endpoint when dualstack is enabled.
Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
Added support for cross account through Id parameter overloading with ARN and allow owner account for some APIs instead of ARN

AWS Cloud Map now supports service-level attributes, allowing you to associate custom metadata directly with services. These attributes can be retrieved, updated, and deleted using the new GetServiceAttributes, UpdateServiceAttributes, and DeleteServiceAttributes API calls.
This release adds examples to several Cloud Map actions.
Adds a new DiscoverInstancesRevision API and also adds InstanceRevision field to the DiscoverInstances API response.
Reverted the throttling exception RequestLimitExceeded for AWS Cloud Map APIs introduced in SDK version 1.12.424 2023-03-09 to previous exception specified in the ErrorCode.
Updated all AWS Cloud Map APIs to provide consistent throttling exception (RequestLimitExceeded)
Updated the ListNamespaces API to support the NAME and HTTP_NAME filters, and the BEGINS_WITH filter condition.
AWS Cloud Map now allows configuring the TTL of the SOA record for a hosted zone to control the negative caching for new services.
Bugfixes - The DiscoverInstances API operation now provides an option to return all instances for health-checked services when there are no healthy instances available.
Bugfix: Improved input validation for RegisterInstance action, InstanceId field
